title: Immersive Vanilla
description: A mid-end vanilla+ modpack focused on immersion, visuals and performance.
body:
# ✦ Immersive Vanilla

> *Minecraft, but better.*

Immersive Vanilla transforms your Minecraft experience without changing what you love. Enhanced visuals, smoother performance, and immersive details — rain sounds, dynamic lights, realistic footsteps, and more — all carefully balanced to feel like the game Mojang always meant to make.

**No overhauls. No magic systems. Just Minecraft, but better.**

---

## 🔧 What's Included

| Category | Highlights |
|---|---|
| ⚡ Performance | Sodium, Iris, FerriteCore, EntityCulling, ModernFix, ImmediatelyFast |
| 🎨 Visuals | Continuity, Particular Reforged, CoolRain, Dynamic Lights, Visuality |
| 🔊 Audio | Sound Physics Remastered, Presence Footsteps, Sounds |
| 🗺️ World | Towns & Towers, Better Snow Coverage, BetterDays |
| 🖥️ UI/QoL | Bobby, Camera Overhaul, AutoHUD, Chat Heads, Vanilla Refresh |

And **MORE!**

---

## ⚠️ Performance Warning

**This is a mid-end modpack.** Performance may vary depending on your hardware.

| | Minimum | Recommended |
|---|---|---|
| **CPU** | i5/i7 Gen 3+ / Ryzen 3+ | i5 8th Gen+ / Ryzen 5 3600+ |
| **RAM** | 6 GB allocated | 8 GB+ allocated |
| **GPU** | Intel HD 4000 / AMD equiv. | GTX 1060 / RX 580+ |
| **FPS** | ~40 fps @ 8 chunks | 60+ fps @ 12 chunks |

> 💡 A dedicated GPU is recommended but not required. Distant Horizons and Voxy are **not included** — adding them will impact performance significantly.

---

## 💎 Optional Addon

For high-end setups, [Photonics](https://modrinth.com/mod/photonics) is compatible with this pack and adds stunning raytracing via Iris. Requires a modern dedicated GPU (RTX / RX 6000+).
